column6: colour comes from food photography and one brand colour; the radial wash on the current landing is a template tell
no gradients on grounds, buttons, cards, text or KPI tiles
dated template signal; backdrop blur is slow on the low-end Android phones vendors and customers use
as page: no glass, glows or backdrop blur
clickable cards only (a card that is a link is a control: hover + focus feedback); static cards get none; hover stays gated off on touch (#503)
content is present at load; per-section fade-up is the commonest template tell and blanks screenshots
not required: at most one deliberate moment, chosen with the dealt direction; none elsewhere
order numbers and references only; prices and times stay in the body face with tabular figures
